sections.title: Art packs
sections.note: Purchased packs. Their licence: use in personal and commercial games, modified or not; no attribution needed; the assets themselves are never resold or shared. Mega VFX 500 is never used to train machine learning or as a style reference; its effects are only imported into the game. The owner confirmed (2026-10-15) that the other WsT packs here (spell, aura, tile and Meadow Monsters packs) have no such clause. The WsT monster packs bought later do: they are never used for machine-learning training, and neither are the four WsT packs bought in October 2026 (wings, head accessories, capes and cloaks, the Hollow Harvest Kit), which may not be shared even modified. The MutterPixel Studio packs (bought 2026-10-16 and later) and the Pocket Cozy Pixels packs may be modified and recoloured, are never used as AI training data or a style reference, and ask for credit (appreciated, not required). Listed here as thanks.
